summary.en: Leading AI hardware and framework provider, offering NeMo framework and pre-trained Megatron large language models.
summary.zh: 领先的AI硬件和框架提供商，提供NeMo框架和预训练的Megatron大型语言模型。

title.en: NVIDIA AI Models - NeMo Framework & Megatron LLMs | Get Model Key
title.zh: NVIDIA AI模型 - NeMo框架和Megatron大模型 | Get Model Key

description.en: Access NVIDIA's NeMo framework and pre-trained Megatron large language models for enterprise AI solutions.
description.zh: 访问NVIDIA的NeMo框架和预训练Megatron大型语言模型，用于企业AI解决方案。

en: NVIDIA AI spans GPUs, NGC catalog assets, and software stacks such as the NeMo framework and Megatron-style large language model tooling for training and deployment.
Developers typically discover models, containers, and enterprise AI resources via catalog.ngc.nvidia.com and NVIDIA’s AI documentation portals.
zh: NVIDIA AI 覆盖 GPU、NGC 目录资源，以及 NeMo 框架、Megatron 类大模型工具链等训练与部署软件栈。
开发者通常通过 catalog.ngc.nvidia.com 与 NVIDIA AI 文档门户发现模型、容器与企业 AI 资源。

en: Open https://catalog.ngc.nvidia.com/ and sign in with an NVIDIA NGC / developer account.
Accept catalog terms and generate or copy the NGC API key / token from your NGC account settings as shown officially.
Use that credential with NGC CLI, containers, or documented NVIDIA AI endpoints.
Revoke compromised keys in the NGC account UI and never commit them to public repos.
zh: 打开 https://catalog.ngc.nvidia.com/ ，使用 NVIDIA NGC / 开发者账号登录。
按官方指引接受目录条款，并在 NGC 账号设置中生成或复制 API Key / Token。
将该凭证用于 NGC CLI、容器拉取或文档中的 NVIDIA AI 接口。
泄露后请在 NGC 账号中吊销，切勿提交到公开仓库。

question.en: Is NGC the same as ChatGPT-style API keys?
question.zh: NGC Key 和 ChatGPT 那种 API Key 一样吗？

answer.en: NGC credentials mainly unlock NVIDIA’s catalog, containers, and related AI tooling—not a generic third-party chat reseller key.
answer.zh: NGC 凭证主要用于 NVIDIA 目录、容器及相关 AI 工具链，不是第三方聊天 Key 转售。

answer.en: See NVIDIA’s NeMo documentation at docs.nvidia.com/nemo-framework/ and related AI portals.
answer.zh: 见 docs.nvidia.com/nemo-framework/ 及相关 NVIDIA AI 文档站点。
